hi traderscape

very welcome and thank you for asking

in QM physiology we have a QM LVL as an LS just to understand that the
smart money put money there to break the recent H and make a HH(that is
reaction to a true zone) so that the QM LVL is important as an target
for us but not always as an entry . as you know price goes from FL to FL
 , so QM formation (assume we are in supply) is an south engulf of a FL and a RT to a FL to grab some more orders and then continue in the direction of engulf . in some cases that FL that price RT to is aligned with the QM LVL OR LS .

so it's not a rule that always price must RT to the exact QM LVL . the RT is to a FL .

hope it helps you.

regards

Salivan

author: Wes
text:
Basically, to conclude: a LS "creates" a kink when price retraces
after a BO/FO right? This kink gives you 2 things: a good entry point
and the place to put your stoploss.

author: Balzak
text:
Hi, salivan thank you for keep helping traders
 I have a question if you dont mind about something you write " every
TT has a Confirmation too in it's scale , we always have an ENG in one
direction". I take TT trades when i see a trick being played in the
present like a trendline that i think it will be broken to get their
stops or something like that, and i put my limit order where a kink
concur with a trick that was played in the past, even if I cant see any
engulf. So am I doing wrong? I should wait for an engulf first always?

Sorry for my bad english haha and thanks.

author: salivan
text:
Hi BalZak

you are very welcome here .

about your question, you are not wrong any way ,there is no need to wait
 for an ENG , assume you want to trade H4 TF in a product , it's only
enough to know the whole story of price from monthly to 4H. then you can
 trade H4 by seeking in to M1 without any confirmation . we as a trader
that trade the market with price action by RTM must understand the
orders and how and if they consumed or not . reading the orders is the
last part of mastering the market . so for me as an answer you are not
wrong as i told but think also in terms of order flow and FOF (Free
Order Flow) .you can do what ITs are doing .

hope it helps you .

regards

Salivan
